author: Ron Kapaun / 3TD Studios
scope: Eight authoring-only base-colour GLB assets. Not an installed world or collision authority.
changes: Keep one explicit highest-detail visual subtree; omit Torque LOD and collision helper siblings.
Retain authored up-axis/unit transforms; no guessed rescaling.
Resolve each obsolete absolute image reference to exactly one same-directory archive texture.
Embed exact PNG/JPEG bytes without resizing or recompression.
Map declarative doubleSided and alphaTest/alphaRef properties; when missing alphaRef use explicit glTF default 0.5.
Reduce UVW coordinates to glTF UV (S/T) channels without modifying positions.
Deduplicate and join compatible primitives without mesh simplification.
Drop unsupported optional FB_ngon_encoding metadata after triangulation; retain rendered triangles.
